meta.description: svg2img conformance corpus. Each case is a small SVG plus assertions derived from the SVG 1.1 specification, not from current output. Pixel coordinates are in the SVG's own user units (every case uses a viewBox equal to its width/height, so user units map 1:1 to pixels). Assertions sample flat interiors, away from antialiased edges.

cases.name: shapes_rect
cases.note: rect: fill covers the interior, corners are exact

cases.name: shapes_rrect
cases.note: rect rx/ry rounds only the corners; the straight edges stay at the rect bounds

cases.name: shapes_circle
cases.note: circle: radius 30 about (50,50)

cases.name: shapes_ellipse
cases.note: ellipse rx 40 ry 20: spans x 10..90, y 30..70

cases.name: shapes_line
cases.note: line is stroked, never filled; sample the midpoint and an off-line point

cases.name: shapes_polyline
cases.note: open polyline with fill=none: only the stroke is painted

cases.name: shapes_polygon
cases.note: polygon auto-closes and fills its interior

cases.name: path_lines
cases.note: H/V/Z close the rect

cases.name: path_cubic
cases.note: C with symmetric control points: filled between the curve and the chord

cases.name: path_quad
cases.note: Q single control point

cases.name: path_arc
cases.note: A rx ry rot large sweep: a half-disc above the chord

cases.name: path_relative
cases.note: lowercase m/h/v/z are relative and equivalent to the absolute form

cases.name: path_evenodd
cases.note: fill-rule=evenodd punches a square hole at 30..70

cases.name: path_nonzero
cases.note: inner subpath wound the other way: nonzero also leaves a hole

cases.name: path_stroke
cases.note: fill=none leaves only the stroke; width 6 centred on y=50

cases.name: transform_translate
cases.note: translate(30,20) moves the 40x40 rect from (10,10) to (40,30)

cases.name: transform_rotate
cases.note: rotate(45 50 50) spins the 20x20 rect about its own centre. The rotated square has half-diagonal 14.14, so its top apex is at y=35.86: row 36 is the antialiased tip, row 38 is inside, row 34 is outside.

cases.name: transform_scale
cases.note: scale(1.5) about the origin, then translate(10,10): the 40x40 rect spans 10..70

cases.name: transform_matrix
cases.note: matrix(1,0,0.5,1,10,10) shears x by 0.5*y and offsets by (10,10)

cases.name: transform_nested
cases.note: nested groups compose: translate(20,0) then scale(2)

cases.name: viewbox_scale
cases.note: viewBox 0 0 100 100 on 200x200 scales 2x; the 30-unit rect at (10,10) covers device (20,20)-(80,80), so sample the interior at (40,40) and the letterbox at (10,10).

cases.name: par_meet
cases.note: xMidYMid meet: 100x100 into 200x100 fits width, centres vertically

cases.name: par_none
cases.note: preserveAspectRatio=none stretches to fill

cases.name: par_slice
cases.note: slice scales to cover, cropping the overflow

cases.name: grad_linear
cases.note: objectBoundingBox linear gradient runs left to right

cases.name: grad_radial
cases.note: radial white centre to black edge

cases.name: grad_focal
cases.note: focal point fx=0.25 pulls the hot spot left of centre

cases.name: grad_spread
cases.note: spreadMethod=repeat wraps the ramp past r=0.5

cases.name: grad_stop_opacity
cases.note: stop-opacity fades the same colour out

cases.name: grad_user_space
cases.note: userSpaceOnUse maps the ramp to user coordinates, not the bbox

cases.name: clip_rect
cases.note: clipPath clips to the inner rect

cases.name: clip_obb
cases.note: objectBoundingBox clip maps the unit circle onto the rect bbox

cases.name: clip_rule
cases.note: clip-rule=evenodd punches a hole in the clip path

cases.name: clip_nested
cases.note: nested clips intersect

cases.name: opacity_group
cases.note: group opacity 0.5 gives alpha ~128

cases.name: opacity_fill
cases.note: fill-opacity applies to the fill only; the stroke stays opaque

cases.name: use_basic
cases.note: use x/y offsets the referenced rect

cases.name: use_transform
cases.note: use transform composes with x/y (x/y default to 0 here)

cases.name: use_symbol
cases.note: symbol renders only through use

cases.name: text_basic
cases.note: bitmap font paints dark pixels inside the em box

cases.name: text_anchor
cases.note: text-anchor=middle centres the run on x=50

cases.name: text_spacing
cases.note: letter-spacing widens the run but keeps the glyphs

cases.name: text_fontsize
cases.note: font-size scales the glyphs: the 36px line paints far more ink than the 12px line (the bitmap font has no hinting, so the small line is thin).

cases.name: style_inline_fill
cases.note: inline style fill overrides the presentation attribute

cases.name: style_inline_opacity
cases.note: opacity as an inline declaration

cases.name: style_element
cases.note: a <style> rule beats a presentation attribute: the class rule sets red, overriding fill="#0000ff" (CSS cascade, SVG 1.1 6.3).

cases.name: units_absolute
cases.note: 1in = 96px in a 120x120 viewport

cases.name: units_percent
cases.note: percentages resolve against the viewport

cases.name: units_em
cases.note: em resolves against the current font size (20), so 2em = 40

cases.name: colors_solid
cases.note: hex, short hex, #rrggbbaa, rgb() integers/percentages, rgba(), hsl(), hsla(), transparent, currentColor

cases.name: stroke_dash
cases.note: dasharray 8 8: 10..18 painted, 18..26 gap

cases.name: stroke_dashoffset
cases.note: dashoffset 8 shifts the pattern: the first dash moves off the start

cases.name: stroke_cap_round
cases.note: round cap extends the line by half the stroke width

cases.name: stroke_cap_butt
cases.note: butt cap stops exactly at the endpoint

cases.name: stroke_join_miter
cases.note: miter join: ratio 1/sin(33.69deg)=1.80 is below miterlimit 10, so the spike is drawn with its apex at y=14.6; it must be present just below the vertex and must not run away past y=10. Sub-pixel coverage at the extreme tip differs from 2D-AA renderers.

cases.name: stroke_join_round
cases.note: round join rounds the vertex instead of mitering it

cases.name: stroke_miterlimit
cases.note: miterlimit 1 bevels the sharp apex: no spike above the vertex

cases.name: stroke_width
cases.note: stroke-width 12 spans y 44..56

cases.name: text_letterspacing
cases.note: letter-spacing adds trailing space after every glyph (including the last), so the run advances visibly

cases.name: color_rgb_int
cases.note: rgb(0,128,0) is an integer triple; percentages are the only form that works today

cases.name: path_cubic_extent
cases.note: The true cubic M10,80 C10,10 90,10 90,80 passes through x=37.1 at y=30, x=16.3 at y=50 and x=10.6 at y=70 (exact Bezier). Chrome agrees; a coarse flattening renders the curve too narrow.

cases.name: use_text_size
cases.note: <use font-size=24> supplies the text size to a <text> with no font-size

cases.name: use_text_anchor
cases.note: text-anchor on <use> is inherited by the referenced text

cases.name: use_letter_spacing
cases.note: letter-spacing on <use> widens the referenced text run

cases.name: use_visibility_inherit
cases.note: visibility:hidden on <use> hides the referenced subtree

cases.name: use_visibility_override
cases.note: visibility:visible on the referenced rect overrides hidden on <use>

cases.name: grad_linear_transform
cases.note: gradientTransform translate(50) shifts the ramp: red at x=50, purple at x=99.

cases.name: grad_radial_transform
cases.note: gradientTransform scale(2) doubles a userSpaceOnUse radial radius.

cases.name: grad_spread_reflect
cases.note: spreadMethod=reflect mirrors the ramp outside [0,1]

cases.name: grad_focal_inside
cases.note: radialGradient cx=0.5 cy=0.5 r=0.5 fx=0.25 fy=0.5. At the centre the ray from the focal point meets the circle at t=1/3, so the colour is 2/3 red + 1/3 blue = (170,0,85). Chrome and this renderer agree within 1/255.

cases.name: par_xmin_ymin
cases.note: preserveAspectRatio xMinYMin meet aligns to the top-left

cases.name: par_xmax_ymax
cases.note: preserveAspectRatio xMaxYMax meet aligns to the bottom-right

cases.name: nested_svg_par
cases.note: nested svg viewBox+preserveAspectRatio maps into its viewport

cases.name: clip_transform
cases.note: clipPath with a transform clips in the transformed space

cases.name: use_symbol_viewbox
cases.note: <use> of a <symbol> establishes a viewport with width/height and viewBox

cases.name: use_symbol_viewbox_par
cases.note: <use> of a <symbol> honours preserveAspectRatio

cases.name: use_style_inherit_stroke
cases.note: <use> supplies stroke to a referenced shape without one

cases.name: use_target_wins
cases.note: explicit target style beats <use> inherited style

cases.name: use_nested_group
cases.note: nested <use> inside a referenced group resolves at the use site offset

cases.name: transform_rotate_cx_cy
cases.note: rotate(a,cx,cy) rotates about the given point

cases.name: transform_skew
cases.note: skewX/skewY shear the coordinate system

cases.name: viewbox_minx_miny
cases.note: viewBox min-x/min-y offsets the user space origin; the rect fills the viewport

cases.name: nested_svg_overflow_hidden
cases.note: nested svg clips overflow by default

cases.name: switch_requiredfeatures
cases.note: requiredFeatures selects the first child whose features are all supported: Filter is implemented, so the red child wins over the green one and the unconditioned third child.

cases.name: switch_systemlanguage
cases.note: systemLanguage selects the English child (a rasteriser has no locale; English is assumed). The French child is skipped and the unconditioned third child never wins.

cases.name: nested_svg_overflow_visible
cases.note: A nested svg clips to its viewport by default; overflow="visible" disables the clip (SVG 1.1 14.3).

cases.name: path_length_dash
cases.note: pathLength=50 on a 90-unit path scales the dash pattern by 1.8: 18 on, 18 off, so ink at 10/50/90 and gaps at 30/70.

cases.name: pattern_user_space
cases.note: userSpaceOnUse pattern: a 20x20 tile with a 10x10 blue square repeats every 20 user units.

cases.name: pattern_bbox
cases.note: objectBoundingBox units: the tile is half the object bbox and the content is expressed as bbox fractions, so the tile is 50x50 with a 25x25 blue quarter.

cases.name: pattern_transform
cases.note: patternTransform="translate(10,0)" shifts the tiling: blue at x=15/35, red at x=5/25.

cases.name: mask_luminance
cases.note: A mask multiplies the element by luminance × alpha: white keeps the red, black removes it.

cases.name: mask_gradient_bbox
cases.note: maskContentUnits="objectBoundingBox" with a gradient: alpha falls from opaque at x=0 to clear at x=100 (luminance × alpha).

cases.name: marker_start_end
cases.note: A marker with refX=refY=5 is centred on each vertex: red discs at (20,50) and (80,50), the path itself black between them.

cases.name: marker_orient_auto
cases.note: orient="auto" rotates the marker to the path direction: the triangle points up-right at the end of the -45 degree line, so its tip is near (87,13).

cases.name: marker_stroke_width
cases.note: markerUnits="strokeWidth" (the default) scales the marker by stroke-width: a 5x5 marker on a 4-unit stroke is 20 units long, so green reaches x=80.

cases.name: css_style_element
cases.note: class beats type, id beats class, a descendant selector applies, and !important beats an inline presentation attribute.

cases.name: tspan_position
cases.note: A tspan with x= places its run absolutely and may change fill; dx/dy offset a run from the current position. AB stays black at x=5, CD is red at x=40, GH sits 5 right and 5 above the end of EF.

cases.name: image_png_data
cases.note: A data:image/png image is decoded and scaled into its viewport: the 2x2 source shows four quadrants in a 40x40 box.

cases.name: image_svg_data
cases.note: A data:image/svg+xml image is parsed and rendered into its viewport, so an embedded SVG behaves like an image.

cases.name: filter_gaussian_blur
cases.note: feGaussianBlur is a separable approximation of a Gaussian: a black square blurred by 6 is half-covered at its edge (alpha ~128 at x=20) and nearly clear 12 units out.

cases.name: filter_flood_composite
cases.note: feFlood fills the filter region with a colour and feComposite operator="in" cuts it to the source alpha, so the result is a solid green square with a transparent surround.

cases.name: filter_offset_merge
cases.note: feOffset shifts the source by 20 units and feMerge paints the original over the shifted copy: blue from x=10 to x=50.

cases.name: filter_color_matrix
cases.note: feColorMatrix type="saturate" values="0" turns red into mid grey; hueRotate="120" turns it green (the matrix preserves luminance, so the green is not fully saturated).

cases.name: filter_morphology
cases.note: feMorphology dilate with radius 4 grows the 20x20 square by 4 units on every side: red from 36 to 63, still clear at 34.

cases.name: filter_blend_multiply
cases.note: feBlend mode="multiply" multiplies the source by a copy shifted 30 units right; the overlap is a darker orange (blending happens in linearRGB, so the green channel squares in linear light).

cases.name: filter_lighting
cases.note: feDiffuseLighting treats the source alpha as a height field: a flat interior has a normal of (0,0,1), so the result is the light colour times N.L, written to sRGB.

cases.name: filter_turbulence
cases.note: feTurbulence generates a noise field; luminanceToAlpha turns it into varying alpha. The exact pattern is implementation-defined, so the assertion is on the spread, not the values.

cases.name: filter_region_default
cases.note: The default filter region is -10%,-10%,120%,120% of the bounding box: the square spans 40..60 and the blur fades to nothing by 36 and 62. Chrome resolves the blur slightly wider than a region-clipped buffer at the region boundary, so the flank assertions are ranges.

cases.name: filter_convolve
cases.note: feConvolveMatrix with a 3x3 box kernel is a 9-tap average: a black/white split blurred across the boundary gives mid grey at the edge.

cases.name: filter_displacement
cases.note: feDisplacementMap offsets each pixel by scale*(channel-0.5) using a gradient map: with scale 20 the red/blue boundary moves by only a couple of pixels, so the split is still visible at x=50.

cases.name: filter_specular
cases.note: feSpecularLighting outputs a premultiplied highlight: a white light gives white with an alpha equal to the specular intensity, which falls off away from the highlight.

cases.name: filter_image_tile
cases.note: feImage decodes an embedded PNG into the filter region and feTile repeats that subregion: the 2x2 source becomes a checker of red and white squares. The exact colours differ between renderers (Chrome converts the image differently), so the assertion is on the colours with a wide tolerance.

cases.name: filter_primitive_units_bbox
cases.note: primitiveUnits="objectBoundingBox" makes dx a fraction of the bounding box: dx=0.1 on a 50-wide square shifts the copy by 5, so the merged shape spans 20..75.

cases.name: text_tref
cases.note: tref inserts the character data of the referenced text element: the referenced run and a directly written run produce the same ink.

cases.name: text_text_path
cases.note: textPath lays the glyphs along the referenced path, each rotated to the tangent: five glyphs start 10% along a curve that spans x=10..150, so the ink stays in the first half of the canvas.

cases.name: text_rotate
cases.note: rotate lists one angle per glyph: I at 0 degrees stays upright, the next at 30 and the last at 60 lean further clockwise, so the ink block grows downward to the right.

cases.name: text_length
cases.note: textLength="120" with lengthAdjust="spacing" stretches the advance so the run is 120 units wide, wider than the unstretched 8-glyph run.

cases.name: text_writing_mode
cases.note: writing-mode="tb" advances downward and rotates the glyphs, so the run is a narrow vertical column at x=20 while the horizontal run stays on one baseline.

cases.name: text_dominant_baseline
cases.note: dominant-baseline="central" moves the alphabetic baseline down by half an em, so the centred run sits lower on the canvas than the default run at the same y.

cases.name: image_external_file
cases.note: An external PNG resolves against the document's directory: a 2x2 RGBA image scaled into a 40x40 box shows its four pixels as quadrants.

cases.name: image_external_jpeg
cases.note: An external baseline JPEG is decoded by the built-in decoder (4:2:0, chroma co-sited), so the quadrants are approximate but clearly separated.

cases.name: shape_rendering_crisp
cases.note: shape-rendering="crispEdges" turns antialiasing off for that element: the right square has almost no partially covered pixels, the left one has many.

cases.name: gradient_linear_rgb
cases.note: color-interpolation="linearRGB" on a gradient interpolates the stops in linear light, so the red-to-blue midpoint is much lighter than in sRGB.
